$schema.description: The schema this file follows, for editors.

name.description: The app name. The one source of the folder ~/.claudalisk/apps/<name>/ that holds the app's state.

hostPrefix.description: The prefix of <hostPrefix>.dev.localhost and of the proxy router names.

databases.description: The app's databases. Scripts handle them by role.

role.description: What the database is for, such as app or identity.

envVar.description: The environment variable that holds its connection string.

ports.description: The host ports the app's dev environment uses. The e2e harness takes free ports, so none are listed for it.

devDb.description: The host port of the dev database.

apiLocal.description: The host port of the API run locally.

uat.description: The uat resources no agent may touch.

composeProject.description: The Compose project name of uat.

volume.description: The Docker volume that holds uat's data.

protectedVolumes.description: More volumes that hold uat data.

askCommands.description: Commands the agent must ask the owner about first.

runnerLabel.description: The label of the CI runners the app uses.

review.description: Extra path globs for the review plan, added to the defaults.

uatData.description: Globs of files that can touch uat data.
